notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Pronoun long safiks bilong Hibru, Tok Pisin i nidim em stret

notes.subject: במותו — 'long dai bilong em'
notes.rationale: KJV 'hope in his death' (man i stret i wetim gutpela samting long dai); ASV 'refuge' (ples bilong ranimap strong); JPS 'even when he is brought to death' — tupa i tok long taim man i dai, narapela i tok long dai bilong man nogut

translation: Long olgeta nogut bilong en, ol i pusim daun man nogut; tasol man i stret i gat ples bilong ranimap strong long dai bilong ⟨em⟩.

tokens.gloss: i gat ples bilong ranimap strong
